The pinnacle... is yours... for now...
Humans... on MY pinnacle? Sentinels, attack!
Grrr... you bite. So do I!
Enough axe. Taste my true blade!
King of the kobolds who guards the top of the Challenge Towers. Fights with axe and buckler — until he draws the long blade hidden on his back.
command.isekai_mahou.towers.island_not_f: No Flying Island found nearby (only new Overworld chunks have them).
command.isekai_mahou.towers.island_tp: Teleported to the Flying Island at %s %s %s.
command.isekai_mahou.towers.not_found: No Challenge Tower found nearby (only new Overworld chunks generated since v1.6 have them).
command.isekai_mahou.towers.tp: Teleported to the Challenge Tower at %s %s %s.
hint.isekai_mahou.towers.affixes: This floor has affixes: hover their names in chat to see what they do.
hint.isekai_mahou.towers.updraft: An Updraft rises to the island: step into the glowing column to go up (sneak to go down).
item.isekai_mahou.tower_teleport_crystal: A blue crystal that remembers the way back.
Hold to use: inside a tower, returns to its entrance; elsewhere, to your respawn point.
item.isekai_mahou.tower_twin_blade.desc: Half of a pair. Alone, it's just a good sword.
item.isekai_mahou.tower_twin_blade.use: With its twin in the other hand — Use: Starlight Torrent, 16 hits in a row (30 s).
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.affixes.hint: Above the ground floor, each wave floor rolls affixes: enemies become Fortified, Volatile, a Horde...
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.affixes.lore: Hover an affix name in chat to read what it does.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.crystal.hint: Tower chests or crafting (amethyst, ender pearl and Mana Crystal). Hold to use.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.enter.hint: Follow the journal compass. Stone in plains, frost in snow, sand in deserts, moss in jungles and swamps; the Sunken one is in the sea (go down from the dock) and the Floating one, in the sky.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.enter.lore: The south door has a sign: "Win or turn back".
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.floors.hint: Each floor has enemy waves or a puzzle. Win and the ceiling Seals vanish, opening the stairs.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.floors.lore: If everyone leaves a floor for 1 minute, the enemies disperse and the wave restarts.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.intro: Ancient towers rise across plains, ice, deserts and jungles — some inside the sea, others in the sky. Each floor is a trial — and at the top, a guardian protects a treasure.
Axe and buckler, sentinels that shield him (kill them!) and, at the end, a hidden long blade.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.lore: Nobody knows who built them. They say whoever reaches the pinnacle comes out stronger — if they come out.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.outro: The pinnacle is yours. From up there, you can see the next tower on the horizon...
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.puzzle.hint: Light every Rune Lever on the north wall. Each one also flips its neighbours.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.puzzle.lore: Tip: start at one end and fix them left to right.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.record.hint: Each floor is timed from waking to victory. Beating your best time counts.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.record.lore: The time shows when the floor falls. Click the Floor Core to see the world record and yours.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.sky_island: Set foot on a Flying Island
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.sky_island.h: Look for islands in the sky. Under each one rises an Updraft: step into it to go up.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.sky_island.l: Old ruins guard chests up there. Sneak inside the well to float back down.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.starburst.hi: Get both Twin Blades (tower vaults and treasure chests), one in each hand, and use them.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.summit.hint: Clear all 7 floors and the Guardian at the top. The pinnacle vault opens with victory.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.summit.lore: The guardian depends on the tower: the Kobold Lord, or a king of the surrounding lands.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.three.hint: Each tower can be conquered only once. Find others around the world.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.three.lore: Stone, frost, sand, forest, sea and sky: six kinds.
journal.isekai_mahou.towers.title: The Challenge Towers
message.isekai_mahou.tower_kobold_lord.n: He switched weapons! His strikes are longer and faster now — keep clear of the marks.
message.isekai_mahou.tower_kobold_lord.s: Sentinels guard the Lord: while 2+ live, he takes half damage!
message.isekai_mahou.tower_teleport_crys: A powerful presence disturbs the crystal!
Teleport! — back to the tower entrance.
Teleport! — back to your respawn point.
message.isekai_mahou.tower_twin_blade.ne: Hold the other Twin Blade in your other hand.
message.isekai_mahou.towers.entered: Challenge Tower! Clear each floor to open the way up — the guardian waits at the pinnacle.
message.isekai_mahou.towers.protected: The tower's magic protects these stones. Conquer the pinnacle first.
message.isekai_mahou.towers.puzzle_hint: Light every rune. Each lever also flips its neighbours.
message.isekai_mahou.towers.roof_denied: The pinnacle's barrier repels you: clear every floor first!
message.isekai_mahou.towers.sky_cushion: The island's magic cushions your fall.
message.isekai_mahou.towers.sky_island: A Flying Island! Ruins of those who lived above the clouds — and what they left behind.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.burning.desc: Enemy hits set you on fire.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.champion.desc: Each wave brings a champion: bigger, double health, glowing.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.horde.desc: Two more creatures in every wave.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.shielded.desc: Enemies spawn with a shield and resistance.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.thorns.desc: Melee hits reflect part of the damage.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.vampiric.desc: Enemies heal from the damage they deal.
tower.isekai_mahou.affix.volatile.desc: Enemies explode 1 s after dying. Step back!
tower.isekai_mahou.kind.combat: Hall of Waves — defeat every enemy
tower.isekai_mahou.kind.puzzle: Hall of Runes — light every rune
tower.isekai_mahou.reset: Nobody stayed on floor %s: the enemies dispersed.
tower.isekai_mahou.time.broadcast: %s broke the record: %s of the %s Tower in %s!
